title: FM27 Guides — Mods, Skins, Logo Packs & Release Dates
description: Football Manager 27 guides for the released game: real-name fix, facepacks, skins, logo packs, tactics checks and wonderkids. Each page gives the install path, the download page and what the publisher does not confirm.
meta: Updated 13 November 2026 · Football Manager 27 released 10 November 2026 · Publisher compatibility claims are reported as stated; this site does not host or test the files.
body:
Football Manager 27 is on sale since 10 November 2026, so this section now describes the released game rather than the Launch Preview. Nothing here is hosted by this site: each page names the maintainer, links their download page, and gives the exact folder the files go into.

Does it work on the released build?

This is the question the old pages dodged, so here is the honest state of it per resource type. “Published after launch” means the maintainer shipped a file or a changelog entry on or after 10 November 2026; it does not mean the author tested every screen.

ResourceLatest release read 13 November 2026What the source statesWhat is not stated
Real Name Fix (sortitoutsi)v6, page updated 13 NovemberShipped after launch; author describes the fix as save-game compatible and supplies blank files that overwrite the old fake namesNo build number is named, so “works on 27.0.x” is not literally on the page
Cut-Out Player Faces2027.01, released 12 NovemberA 7,304-file change pack on top of the 2027.00 base; Windows install needs no preferences changeThe Mac instructions block still says it is awaiting feedback from Mac users
TCM27 logosPack dated 3 November, update TCM27.0 after thatExplicit FM27 pack with Windows, Mac and Game Pass paths512px logos can look pixelated at Medium/Small display sizes; that is a display setting, not a broken install
Interface skinsPriisek v1.5 on 13 November; Turkey club skins on 7 NovemberBoth authors kept publishing after launch; Priisek added an installer on 11 NovemberNeither page names a build; the Turkey page says its packages have not been claimed as in-game tested
Rule of thumb: a file published after 10 November is written against the released game, but only the maintainer can tell you which screens they checked. Install one change at a time so a broken screen is traceable to one file.

Where the files come from

Every download link on these pages points at the maintainer's own page — sortitoutsi for the real-name fix, faces and skins, TCMLogos for logo packs, and the individual skin authors for their interfaces. That is deliberate: those pages carry the current version number, the current instructions and the author's own support thread, and re-hosting them here would only produce a stale copy.

What this site adds is the part the download pages usually leave implicit: which folder the files go in per platform, what a change pack requires before it, and which claims are still unconfirmed.
